text_a: Do not restart the servers that host the database during backups.
text_b: Restart the servers that do not host the database during backups.
what_differs: The negation moves from the restart action to the relative clause, so the set of servers allowed to be restarted changes and restarting DB hosts is no longer forbidden.

text_a: Los empleados que no han firmado el contrato pueden acceder al sistema.
text_b: Los empleados que han firmado el contrato no pueden acceder al sistema.
what_differs: The negation moves between the relative clause and the main verb, reversing who may access the system.

text_a: Não envie o relatório ao cliente, mas arquive a cópia interna.
text_b: Envie o relatório ao cliente, mas não arquive a cópia interna.
what_differs: The prohibition applies to sending in A but to archiving in B.

text_a: Approve invoices below 500 dollars; do not notify finance.
text_b: Do not approve invoices below 500 dollars; notify finance.
what_differs: The prohibition applies to notifying finance in A but to approving in B.

text_a: No reinicie el servicio y avise al equipo de soporte.
text_b: No reinicie el servicio ni avise al equipo de soporte.
what_differs: A requires notifying support, while B prohibits notifying support as well as restarting.

text_a: Não deixe a porta aberta quando sair do laboratório.
text_b: Deixe a porta aberta quando não sair do laboratório.
what_differs: The negation moves from leaving the door open to leaving the lab, inverting the rule.

text_a: Do not share the password with anyone, including your manager.
text_b: Never share the password with anybody, your manager included.

text_a: No apague el equipo ni cierre sesión antes de terminar la copia.
text_b: Antes de terminar la copia, no apague el equipo y tampoco cierre sesión.

text_a: Funcionários que não completaram o treinamento não podem operar a máquina.
text_b: A máquina não pode ser operada por funcionários que não completaram o treinamento.

text_a: Do not open attachments from unknown senders, but report them to security.
text_b: Report attachments from unknown senders to security, and do not open them.

text_a: No se permite fumar en la sala de servidores.
text_b: Está prohibido fumar en la sala de servidores.

text_a: Everyone except the contractor must complete the form.
text_b: Everyone except the contractors must complete the form.
what_differs: Singular exception (one contractor) versus plural exception (all contractors), so the exempt set differs.

text_a: Actualice todos los servidores excepto el de producción.
text_b: Actualice todos los servidores excepto el de respaldo.
what_differs: A exempts the production server while B exempts the backup server.

text_a: Reembolse todas as despesas, a não ser que não tenham recibo.
text_b: Reembolse todas as despesas, a não ser que tenham recibo.
what_differs: A excludes expenses without a receipt; B excludes expenses with a receipt.

text_a: Refunds are issued within 30 days unless the item was customized.
text_b: Refunds are issued within 30 days unless the item was damaged.
what_differs: The excluded category is customized items in A but damaged items in B.

text_a: Archive todos los reportes excepto los borradores confidenciales.
text_b: Archive todos los reportes excepto los borradores y los confidenciales.
what_differs: A exempts only drafts that are confidential; B exempts all drafts plus all confidential reports, a larger set.

text_a: Todos os acessos serão revogados, exceto o da administradora.
text_b: Todos os acessos serão revogados, exceto o dos administradores.
what_differs: One administrator's access is preserved in A while all administrators' accesses are preserved in B.

text_a: Unless it is raining, the drill takes place outdoors.
text_b: The drill takes place outdoors, except when it is raining.

text_a: Todos deben fichar, excepto el personal de limpieza.
text_b: Salvo el personal de limpieza, todos deben fichar.

text_a: Faça backup de todos os diretórios, exceto /tmp.
text_b: Faça backup de todas as pastas, menos a /tmp.

text_a: Apart from the night shift, all employees get a 30-minute break.
text_b: All employees, other than those on the night shift, get a 30-minute break.

text_a: Se cobrará el envío a todos los pedidos salvo a los superiores a 50 euros.
text_b: Todos los pedidos tienen gastos de envío, excepto aquellos que superan los 50 euros.

text_a: Can I skip the review? No, merge after two approvals.
text_b: Can I skip the review? Yes, merge after two approvals.
what_differs: The short answer flips from No to Yes, so skipping the review is forbidden in A but allowed in B.

text_a: ¿Debo avisar al jefe? No, avise a recursos humanos.
text_b: ¿Debo avisar al jefe? No avise a recursos humanos.
what_differs: Dropping the comma turns the instruction to notify HR into a prohibition on notifying HR.

text_a: Posso abrir o portão? Não, abra a janela.
text_b: Posso abrir o portão? Não abra a janela.
what_differs: A instructs opening the window; B prohibits opening the window.

text_a: Should we update the client? Don't, call them tomorrow.
text_b: Should we update the client? Don't call them tomorrow.
what_differs: A orders a call tomorrow after declining the update; B forbids calling tomorrow.

text_a: ¿Puedo imprimir los contratos? Sí, máximo 3 copias.
text_b: ¿Puedo imprimir los contratos? Sí, mínimo 3 copias.
what_differs: The bound is an upper limit of 3 copies in A but a lower limit of 3 in B.

text_a: Do I need approval? No, just notify your manager.
text_b: Do I need approval? Not required; simply let your manager know.

text_a: ¿Puedo reiniciar el router? No, primero llame a soporte.
text_b: ¿Puedo reiniciar el router? No; llame primero a soporte.

text_a: Posso sair mais cedo? Sim, desde que avise o gerente.
text_b: Posso sair mais cedo? Sim — contanto que avise o gerente.

text_a: Can we ship on Friday? No, ship on Monday.
text_b: Can we ship on Friday? Not allowed. Ship on Monday instead.

text_a: ¿Hay que cifrar el disco? Sí, con AES-256.
text_b: ¿Hay que cifrar el disco? Sí; use AES-256.

text_a: Devo ligar para o cliente? Não, envie um e-mail.
text_b: Devo ligar para o cliente? Não. Mande um e-mail.

text_a: Submit the report by Friday and pay the invoice on Monday.
text_b: Submit the report on Monday and pay the invoice by Friday.
what_differs: The Friday and Monday timings are swapped between the two actions.

text_a: Envíe el informe a las 9:00 y cierre la caja a las 17:00.
text_b: Envíe el informe a las 17:00 y cierre la caja a las 9:00.
what_differs: The clock times of the two actions are swapped.

text_a: Faça o backup às 22h e reinicie o servidor às 23h.
text_b: Faça o backup às 23h e reinicie o servidor às 22h.
what_differs: Backup and restart times are swapped, reversing their order.

text_a: Approve the budget before March 1 and publish it after March 15.
text_b: Approve the budget after March 1 and publish it before March 15.
what_differs: The before/after direction of each deadline is inverted for both actions.

text_a: Revise los permisos antes del jueves y archive los registros después del viernes.
text_b: Revise los permisos después del viernes y archive los registros antes del jueves.
what_differs: The time constraints are swapped between reviewing permissions and archiving logs.

text_a: Envie a fatura na segunda e pague o fornecedor na sexta.
text_b: O fornecedor deve ser pago na sexta; a fatura, enviada na segunda.

text_a: Back up the database at 2 a.m. and restart the server at 3 a.m.
text_b: Restart the server at 03:00, after backing up the database at 02:00.

text_a: Cierre el turno a las 18:00 y entregue las llaves a las 18:30.
text_b: A las 18:30 entregue las llaves; el turno se cierra a las 18:00.

text_a: Preencha o formulário até quinta e envie o comprovante até sexta.
text_b: Até sexta, envie o comprovante; o formulário deve ser preenchido até quinta.

text_a: Submit timesheets by Friday noon and expenses by Monday.
text_b: Expenses are due Monday; timesheets are due by noon on Friday.

text_a: Pague la factura antes del 5 de mayo y confirme el pago el 6.
text_b: El 6 confirme el pago; la factura debe pagarse antes del 5 de mayo.

text_a: Employees must report incidents and may request a copy of the report.
text_b: Employees may report incidents and must request a copy of the report.
what_differs: The modals must and may are swapped between reporting and requesting a copy.

text_a: El técnico debe apagar el equipo y puede avisar al supervisor.
text_b: El técnico puede apagar el equipo y debe avisar al supervisor.
what_differs: Obligation and permission are swapped between shutting down the equipment and notifying the supervisor.

text_a: O gerente deve aprovar o orçamento e pode delegar a revisão.
text_b: O gerente pode aprovar o orçamento e deve delegar a revisão.
what_differs: Obligatory and optional status are swapped between approving the budget and delegating the review.

text_a: Staff should log out at night and can leave the laptop at the office.
text_b: Staff can log out at night and should leave the laptop at the office.
what_differs: Should and can are swapped between logging out and leaving the laptop.

text_a: Los clientes pueden cancelar el pedido y deben conservar el recibo.
text_b: Los clientes deben cancelar el pedido y pueden conservar el recibo.
what_differs: The permission and obligation are swapped between cancelling the order and keeping the receipt.

text_a: A equipe deve testar o patch antes de aplicá-lo e pode adiar o reinício.
text_b: A equipe pode testar o patch antes de aplicá-lo e deve adiar o reinício.
what_differs: Testing the patch becomes optional and postponing the restart becomes mandatory in B.

text_a: O operador deve usar luvas e pode usar óculos.
text_b: As luvas são obrigatórias para o operador; os óculos são opcionais.

text_a: Applicants may submit a cover letter and must attach a resume.
text_b: A resume must be attached by applicants, who may also submit a cover letter.

text_a: El personal debe usar casco y puede traer su propio chaleco.
text_b: Es obligatorio que el personal use casco; traer chaleco propio es opcional.

text_a: Users can reset their password but must not reuse the old one.
text_b: Users are allowed to reset their password; reusing the old one is forbidden.

text_a: Os visitantes podem tirar fotos, mas devem pedir autorização para filmar.
text_b: Tirar fotos é permitido aos visitantes; para filmar, é obrigatório pedir autorização.

text_a: Each team needs at least 3 engineers and at most 5 interns.
text_b: Each team needs at most 3 engineers and at least 5 interns.
what_differs: The at least and at most bounds are swapped between engineers and interns.

text_a: Se permiten más de 10 usuarios por licencia y menos de 3 dispositivos.
text_b: Se permiten menos de 10 usuarios por licencia y más de 3 dispositivos.
what_differs: More than and fewer than are swapped between users and devices.

text_a: Cada servidor deve ter no mínimo 2 discos e no máximo 8 gigabytes de RAM.
text_b: Cada servidor deve ter no máximo 2 discos e no mínimo 8 gigabytes de RAM.
what_differs: The minimum and maximum bounds are swapped between disks and RAM.

text_a: Withdrawals over 1,000 dollars need two signatures.
text_b: Withdrawals of 1,000 dollars or more need two signatures.
what_differs: A withdrawal of exactly 1,000 dollars needs two signatures in B but not in A.

text_a: No más de 3 personas por turno y al menos 2 turnos al día.
text_b: Al menos 3 personas por turno y no más de 2 turnos al día.
what_differs: The bounds are swapped between people per shift and shifts per day.

text_a: Fewer than 5 attempts are allowed per hour.
text_b: A maximum of 4 attempts per hour is allowed.

text_a: Cada equipo debe tener al menos 3 ingenieros.
text_b: Cada equipo debe contar con 3 ingenieros o más.

text_a: Não use mais de 2 GB por usuário.
text_b: Cada usuário pode usar no máximo 2 GB.

text_a: Pack no more than 12 bottles per box and at least 6.
text_b: Each box must hold between 6 and 12 bottles, inclusive.

text_a: Se requieren más de 2 firmas para montos superiores a 500 euros.
text_b: Los montos de más de 500 euros requieren 3 firmas o más.

text_a: Cada turno precisa de pelo menos 4 enfermeiros e no máximo 2 estagiários.
text_b: Em cada turno, são necessários 4 enfermeiros ou mais e até 2 estagiários.

text_a: The manager approves the request from the employee.
text_b: The employee approves the request from the manager.
what_differs: The approver and the requester roles are swapped.

text_a: El cliente notificará al proveedor del retraso.
text_b: El proveedor notificará al cliente del retraso.
what_differs: Who notifies whom is reversed.

text_a: O auditor revisa os registros que o administrador gerou.
text_b: O administrador revisa os registros que o auditor gerou.
what_differs: The reviewer and the generator of the records are swapped.

text_a: Finance must be notified by the team lead.
text_b: The team lead must be notified by finance.
what_differs: The passive agent and the notified party are reversed.

text_a: El supervisor firma el formulario que el técnico entrega.
text_b: El técnico firma el formulario que el supervisor entrega.
what_differs: Signer and deliverer roles are swapped.

text_a: O fornecedor deve pagar a multa ao comprador.
text_b: O comprador deve pagar a multa ao fornecedor.
what_differs: The payer and the payee of the fine are swapped.

text_a: The security team reviews every access request.
text_b: Every access request is reviewed by the security team.

text_a: El cajero entrega el recibo al cliente.
text_b: El recibo es entregado por el cajero al cliente.

text_a: O diretor aprova os pedidos que os gerentes enviam.
text_b: Os pedidos enviados pelos gerentes são aprovados pelo diretor.

text_a: HR sends the offer letter and the candidate signs it.
text_b: The candidate signs the offer letter that HR sends.

text_a: Soporte técnico asigna cada ticket al ingeniero de guardia.
text_b: El ingeniero de guardia recibe de soporte técnico la asignación de cada ticket.

text_a: O cliente paga a taxa e o banco emite o comprovante.
text_b: O comprovante é emitido pelo banco, depois que o cliente paga a taxa.

text_a: Restart the service only if the health check fails.
text_b: Restart the service if the health check fails.
what_differs: A makes the failed health check the sole trigger for restarting; B does not forbid restarting in other cases.

text_a: Escale el incidente si el cliente es premium y el fallo dura más de una hora.
text_b: Escale el incidente si el cliente es premium o el fallo dura más de una hora.
what_differs: A requires both conditions to escalate; B escalates when either condition holds.

text_a: A não ser que o cliente peça, não envie fatura impressa.
text_b: Se o cliente pedir, não envie fatura impressa.
what_differs: A allows a printed invoice when the customer asks; B forbids it precisely when the customer asks.

text_a: If the alarm sounds, evacuate and call security.
text_b: If the alarm sounds, evacuate; call security if anyone is missing.
what_differs: Calling security is unconditional in A but conditional on someone missing in B.

text_a: Cuando el servidor falle, reinícielo y avise.
text_b: Cuando el servidor falle dos veces, reinícielo y avise.
what_differs: The condition requires two failures in B instead of any failure.

text_a: Se a meta for atingida, o bônus é pago a todos os funcionários.
text_b: Se a meta for atingida, o bônus é pago aos funcionários ativos.
what_differs: The bonus covers all employees in A but only active employees in B.

text_a: Unless the customer objects, send the invoice by email.
text_b: Send the invoice by email, provided the customer does not object.

text_a: Solo si el paciente firma el consentimiento se realiza el procedimiento.
text_b: El procedimiento se realiza únicamente cuando el paciente firma el consentimiento.

text_a: Se a senha expirar, o usuário deve redefini-la.
text_b: O usuário deve redefinir a senha quando ela expirar.

text_a: If the load exceeds 80 percent, add a node; otherwise leave the cluster as is.
text_b: Add a node when the load is above 80 percent, and leave the cluster unchanged when it is not.

text_a: Si llueve, el evento se traslada al salón; si no, se hace en el patio.
text_b: El evento será en el patio, a menos que llueva, en cuyo caso será en el salón.

text_a: Só reembolse o pedido se o produto estiver lacrado.
text_b: O reembolso só é permitido quando o produto está lacrado.
